summary: Makes OSS the sole EnterpriseGlue product host and routes independently delivered capabilities through public plugin contracts.
userImpact: The EnterpriseGlue OSS application remains the product host; independently delivered plugins continue to install through the supported plugin platform.

instructions: No host upgrade action is required; plugin owners should qualify against the supported OSS host and plugin API versions.

notes: No database schema or persisted data changes are included.

security: Removes obsolete OSS automation credentials and repository dispatches that targeted the retired standalone EE delivery path.
documentation: Updates contributor architecture, release guidance, and Codex workflows for the OSS-host and independent-plugin model.
rollback: Revert the workflow and documentation commit; no data rollback is required.
validation: CI contract tests reject future OSS workflow dispatches to the retired EE repository.
The versioned Codex plugin and every bundled skill pass the repository and official validators.
